title: Replace live deployment with current build and remove production publish blockers

requirements.summary: Fix and complete DEPLOYMENT.md with valid Markdown and an end-to-end publish checklist that preserves the exact production slug `pkcurbancapital`.
acceptanceCriteria: `frontend/DEPLOYMENT.md` renders correctly as Markdown (no broken/unterminated fenced blocks).
The document includes a clear, sequential checklist for publishing the frontend + backend (as applicable) in this project.
The document explicitly instructs to set the publish slug/subdomain to exactly `pkcurbancapital` and warns against draft/random suffixes.

file_operations.description: Rewrite the deployment guide to be complete, valid Markdown (fix the unterminated fenced block) and provide a sequential, end-to-end publish checklist. Include an explicit, prominent instruction that the production publish slug/subdomain must be exactly `pkcurbancapital` (no draft/random suffixes), and add a short verification section for confirming the live site serves the latest build.

requirements.summary: Resolve TypeScript/production build compilation errors without touching immutable frontend paths.
acceptanceCriteria: `npm run build` (or the platform’s production build step) completes successfully with no TypeScript errors.
No changes are made to immutable paths (e.g., `frontend/src/main.tsx`, `frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts`, `frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts(x)`, `frontend/src/components/ui/*`).

file_operations.description: Fix likely production TypeScript build errors by correcting the refs typing (e.g., ensure `useRef` allows null and aligns with `ref` expectations) and by keeping all changes confined to this file (do not touch immutable paths).

Fix TypeScript build issues around `forwardRef` typing by explicitly typing the props parameter (even if empty) and ensuring the forwarded ref type matches the `<section>` element usage; keep behavior unchanged.

Fix TypeScript build issues around `forwardRef` typing by explicitly typing the props parameter (even if empty) and ensuring the forwarded ref type matches the `<section>` element usage; keep behavior unchanged.

requirements.summary: Ensure publish configuration and docs publish the current build to the same production slug `pkcurbancapital` to replace the previously live version.
acceptanceCriteria: Publishing the current build to slug/subdomain `pkcurbancapital` results in the live URL serving the current build (replacing the previous live version).
No separate/draft slug is used for the final live publish.

file_operations.description: Create a small, repo-local publish configuration file that pins the required production slug/subdomain to exactly `pkcurbancapital` and documents that this value must be used for the final live publish (not a draft/random suffix).

Update the documented publish steps to reference the pinned production slug/subdomain `pkcurbancapital` (and the new `frontend/deploy.config.json`), and to clearly instruct that the final publish must target the same production slug to replace the previously live version.
